machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives complete.

1. **DONE** — Ticket `fwrd90-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (ref **RD-1015**), initially in status Draft on its detail page.
2. **DONE** — Part `fwrd90-n1 RD Part A` added (cost 100, markup 25%, qty 1); app-computed price: **$125.00**.
3. **DONE** — Part `fwrd90-n1 RD Part B` added (cost 200, markup 25%, qty 1); app-computed price: **$250.00** (parts total $375.00 at that point).
4. **DONE** — Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup 25, qty 1 unchanged); app-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (parts total $437.50).
5. **DONE** — Status set to **Ready**. Precondition discovered: the app rejected "Mark Ready" with the exact message "Ticket is not ready / Part "fwrd90-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier / Part "fwrd90-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier" — i.e. every part required a supplier. Satisfied by editing each part and setting Supplier = "ACME Supplies" (cost/markup/qty untouched); "Mark Ready" then succeeded with no error, and the page showed Status "Ready" with actions "Mark Draft"/"Mark Closed".
6. **DONE** — Both parts deleted via their Delete buttons (each with a "Confirm" modal → "Delete part"); parts table shows "No parts on this ticket yet." with 0 parts. Ticket then archived via "Archive ticket" (no dialog, no extra precondition — it was already Ready): button changed to "Unarchive ticket", header shows Status "Ready" + "Archived" badge, and RD-1015 no longer appears in the default active tickets list (visible only with "Show archived", listed as "RD-1015 | fwrd90-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Not recorded | Ready | 0"). Nothing created by this run remains active.
